criteria.description: Local unit tests cover telemetry, acceptance freshness, executable-plan validation and benchmark contracts.
The owner-maintained executable Goal passport is valid before work begins.
The checked deterministic benchmark remains a regression oracle; it is not proof of production token savings.
Goal Runner workflow, handoff continuity and local architecture invariants are consistent.
Manifest-backed installation is byte-idempotent, rejects unmanaged paths, rolls back safely and uninstalls cleanly across source version drift.
Explicit fresh file review confirms scope, compatibility, security, rollback and no concurrent writer violation; re-prove after relevant repository changes.
